+**English** | [Português (Brasil)](./GUIDE.pt-BR.md)
+
+# WPPConnect Team README standard
+
+Help a new reader identify the project, choose the right component and reach a first useful result. Keep `README.md` in English and a complete, equivalent `README.pt-BR.md` in Brazilian Portuguese at the repository root. Update both in the same change. Other existing languages remain available.
+
+## Verify before editing
+
+Inventory accessible repositories through the Git provider and local remotes. Record the default branch, reviewed SHA, visibility, archived/fork flags, purpose, audience, project type, current READMEs/translations, legal files, publication metadata, runtime requirements, scripts, examples, documentation, community and funding sources. A non-archived flag alone does not prove active maintenance or production readiness. Record evidence and uncertainty; never infer a license from the organization website.
+
+Read local contributor instructions and preserve unrelated work. Use a separate branch/checkout where needed. This standard changes documentation and necessary supporting files; it does not authorize releases, account operations or changes to legal terms. Keep private project names, security advisory details and operational information out of public repositories.
+
+## Files and header
+
+Use [the English template](templates/README.md) and [the Portuguese template](templates/README.pt-BR.md). Replace every placeholder before applying them. Keep the language selector as the first visible line:
+
+```markdown
+**English** | [Português (Brasil)](./README.pt-BR.md)
+```
+
+```markdown
+[English](./README.md) | **Português (Brasil)**
+```
+
+Follow with an existing official logo when available, the official project name, a one-sentence purpose, the relationship to WPPConnect Team, quick links to getting started/documentation/contributing/support, and a small badge row. Use meaningful alt text and keep essential information in text. Preserve upstream logos and authorship in forks. Prefer a `<picture>` with existing light/dark assets when available; do not invent a logo or license badge to fill the header.
+
+## Section order
+
+| English | Brazilian Portuguese | Requirement |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Overview | Visão geral | Required: purpose, audience, scope, maintenance limitations. |
+| Features | Funcionalidades | Required: confirmed capabilities; label experiments explicitly. |
+| Getting started | Primeiros passos | Required: prerequisites, installation/access and first useful result. |
+| Configuration | Configuração | When applicable: minimum settings and authoritative reference. |
+| Documentation | Documentação | Required: real guides, API references and examples. |
+| WPPConnect ecosystem | Ecossistema WPPConnect | Required: explain relevant relationships; a small table is optional. |
+| Support the project | Apoie o projeto | Required for maintained team projects; distinguish fork/upstream beneficiaries. |
+| Contributing | Como contribuir | Required: code, tests, examples, docs, translations and synchronized READMEs. |
+| Community and support | Comunidade e suporte | Required: where to ask questions, report bugs and report security issues privately. |
+| License | Licença | Required: actual legal evidence or an explicit unresolved status. |
+
+Add troubleshooting, compatibility, security, project status, acknowledgments or sponsors when they help. Link long operational/API catalogs from maintained documentation. If moving existing content, preserve useful instructions, credit and notices, fix relative paths and update references to migrated translations. Mark historical examples clearly instead of presenting obsolete commands as the recommended path. Avoid duplicate competing READMEs in `.github/` or `docs/` that obscure the root entry point.
+
+## Voice and technical accuracy
+
+Use **WPPConnect Team** for the organization and retain official project/package names. Write clear, direct, welcoming prose. Avoid empty superlatives, emoji clutter and unverified claims about performance, stability, popularity, compatibility or releases. Use a simple hyphen for separators; do not use Unicode U+2014.
+
+Check package/image names against publication metadata and the registry. A manifest name does not prove publication. Distinguish source capabilities from published artifacts. Keep commands consistent with actual scripts and lockfiles; state declared minimum runtimes or the exact CI runtime without inventing support ranges. Identify shell-specific commands. Show a minimal runnable example with expected output or UI result and required configuration. Do not include real tokens, keys, session files or personal account data. If a test needs credentials, a WhatsApp session or external services, state what was checked statically and what remains unexecuted.
+
+## Adapt by project type
+
+| Type | Getting-started focus |
+| --- | --- |
+| Library | Correct package, supported runtime, import, minimal API usage and expected result. |
+| Server | Source/image choice, required secrets, persistence, start command, health/API check and session setup reference. |
+| CLI | Real binary name, install, `--help`, first command and underlying service requirements. |
+| Web/mobile application | Backend/native SDK requirements, local start, first screen and build/device limitations. |
+| Extension | Verified store/source installation, build/download requirements, unpacked loading and privacy policy. |
+| Documentation | Published site, content locations, local preview/build and localization workflow. |
+| Schema/data/tooling | Local read/encode/report example, provenance, update side effects and access requirements. |
+| Fork | Upstream URL/authorship/license, confirmed purpose, source/package differences and separate support beneficiaries. |
+| Archived/discontinued | Accurate status, preserved useful history and documented alternatives; do not unarchive. |
+
+## Badges
+
+Aim for four to six useful badges when real data exists, and fewer when it does not. Each badge must link to its own authoritative destination: actual license file, published package/release, existing workflow or official support page. Match workflow filename and default branch. Avoid stale maintenance metrics, badges for unrelated repositories, private CI badges that public image services cannot read, and duplicate version/build badges. A static documentation/support badge is acceptable when it has a real destination. Render the header in narrow layouts and both color themes.
+
+## Official community and funding sources
+
+Use the [institutional website](https://wppconnect.io/), the [organization profile](../../profile/README.md) and each repository's checked-in community/security/funding files as sources. Current institutional channels include [Discord](https://discord.gg/JU5JGGKGNG), [Telegram](https://t.me/wppconnect) and [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/c/wppconnect). Existing WhatsApp invitations vary between repositories; verify the destination before selecting one as the canonical invitation. Preserve upstream community channels in forks.
+
+The shared campaign destination is **[WPPConnect on Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/wppconnect)**, linked by the institutional site and checked during the 2026-10-31 rollout. Verify it again when changing funding copy. Include a short **Support WPPConnect** link near the top and the following section later:
+
+> WPPConnect is maintained by an open-source community. Your support helps fund maintenance, infrastructure, documentation, and the people working on the ecosystem.
+>
+> If WPPConnect helps your project or business, consider making a one-time contribution or becoming a recurring supporter.
+
+Primary CTA: **[Support WPPConnect on Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/wppconnect)**.
+
+Use the equivalent Portuguese copy in the paired guide/template. Contributions are voluntary. Link to the official page for current goals, totals, tiers and benefits instead of copying changing financial information. Invite code, tests, documentation, translations and detailed issue reports as nonfinancial contributions.
+
+Read `FUNDING.yml` before editing. Many team repositories name `joaosouz4dev`, `manfe` and the WPPConnect collective; some have other beneficiaries. Preserve the actual file's beneficiaries. Forks can keep upstream sponsors and add clearly separated WPPConnect ecosystem support, without implying upstream endorsement or redirecting upstream revenue. Include Pix, Sponsors or other payment destinations only with repository/institutional evidence. Do not invent payment keys, sponsor lists, response guarantees or donation benefits. Donations, sponsorships and separately offered commercial services must remain distinguishable.
+
+## License and credits
+
+Inspect `LICENSE*`, `COPYING*`, `NOTICE*`, package metadata, source headers and component-level terms. Link relatively to the actual legal file and use the correct name/SPDX when established. Keep badge, prose and metadata consistent. Preserve original legal documents, copyright lines, upstream attribution and third-party notices. Translate editorial explanation, not legal text. Multiple licenses or dependencies with their own terms must be identified where relevant.
+
+If a license is absent or evidence conflicts, record the discrepancy for maintainers, state it in both READMEs and finish independent documentation work. Do not select a license, add an unsupported badge or silently amend a manifest. The institutional site's broad marketing wording does not override a repository's legal files.
+
+## Maintain both languages
+
+1. Verify the technical change and update the English and Portuguese files together.
+2. Translate headings, explanation, setup instructions, contribution calls and alt text. Keep package names, commands, environment variables and API identifiers unchanged.
+3. Keep the same section order, capabilities, warnings, prerequisites and technically equivalent examples. Portuguese readers must be able to complete the initial workflow without consulting the English README. Further API/reference documentation may remain in its existing language, labeled when useful.
+4. Fix language-specific anchors and relative links. Preserve other languages and update callers if a translation path moves.
+5. Run the [review checklist](CHECKLIST.md), inspect the diff and render both files. The optional `python tools/check_readmes.py PATH_TO_REPOSITORY` checks root navigation, section order/parity, fenced examples, local targets/anchors, basic image alt text and unresolved placeholders using Python 3. It does not validate external URLs, GitHub layout, semantic translation, runtime behavior, legal interpretation or official payment ownership; review those separately. It deliberately ignores historical reference documents and templates.
+6. Record checks, limitations and unresolved maintainer decisions in the change description. Recheck language parity whenever installation, configuration, features, examples, licensing or funding changes.

+Open-source tools for building WhatsApp Web automations, bots, integrations,

+WPPConnect helps developers turn WhatsApp Web into programmable infrastructure:

+  custom backends.
+- Group, contact, chat, profile, and presence automation.

+## Core projects

+

+automation layer.
+
+### [WPPConnect Server](https://github.com/wppconnect-team/wppconnect-server)
+
+A REST API built on top of WPPConnect. Use it when you want a server that is
+already structured for sessions, tokens, routes, webhooks, media, and external
+system integrations.
+
+### [WA-JS](https://github.com/wppconnect-team/wa-js)
+
+The JavaScript layer that exports WhatsApp Web functions and exposes the `WPP`
+runtime. Use it when you need lower-level access to WhatsApp Web internals,
+browser injection, events, and module-level behavior.
+
+### [WPPConnect Server Go](https://github.com/wppconnect-team/wppconnect-server-go)
+
+A Go implementation focused on a lighter runtime and API compatibility with the
+Node server where possible. Use it when you want to explore a lower-resource
+server path.

+"""Check applied bilingual root READMEs using only the Python 3 standard library.
+
+Usage: python tools/check_readmes.py path/to/repository [more/repositories ...]
+External URLs, historical reference documents and templates are not checked.
+"""
+import argparse
+import html
+import json
+import re
+import sys
+import unicodedata
+from pathlib import Path
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
+
+SECTIONS = [
+    ('Overview', 'Visão geral'), ('Features', 'Funcionalidades'),
+    ('Getting started', 'Primeiros passos'), ('Configuration', 'Configuração'),
+    ('Documentation', 'Documentação'), ('WPPConnect ecosystem', 'Ecossistema WPPConnect'),
+    ('Support the project', 'Apoie o projeto'), ('Contributing', 'Como contribuir'),
+    ('Community and support', 'Comunidade e suporte'), ('License', 'Licença'),
+]
+NAV = ['**English** | [Português (Brasil)](./README.pt-BR.md)',
+       '[English](./README.md) | **Português (Brasil)**']
+
+
+def prose(text):
+    return re.sub(r'(?ms)^(`{3,}|~{3,})[^\n]*\n.*?^\1\s*$', '', text)
+
+
+def slug(value):
+    value = html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', value)).strip().lower()
+    value = re.sub(r'[`*_~]', '', value)
+    return ''.join(c for c in value if c in '-_ ' or unicodedata.category(c)[0] in 'LN').replace(' ', '-')
+
+
+def anchors(text):
+    result = set(re.findall(r'\bid=["\']([^"\']+)', text))
+    seen = {}
+    for title in re.findall(r'(?m)^#{1,6}\s+(.+?)\s*#*$', prose(text)):
+        key = slug(title)
+        index = seen.get(key, 0)
+        result.add(key + ('-' + str(index) if index else ''))
+        seen[key] = index + 1
+    return result
+
+
+def destinations(text):
+    body = prose(text)
+    # Balanced parentheses cover common Markdown paths and URLs.
+    for match in re.finditer(r'\]\((<?(?:[^\s()]|\([^)]*\))+>?)', body):
+        yield match[1].strip('<>')
+    for match in re.finditer(r'\b(?:href|src|srcset)=["\']([^"\']+)', body):
+        yield html.unescape(match[1])
+
+
+def check_links(path):
+    errors = []
+    for dest in destinations(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')):
+        parts = urlsplit(dest)
+        if parts.scheme or parts.netloc:
+            continue
+        target = (path.parent / unquote(parts.path)).resolve() if parts.path else path
+        if not target.exists():
+            errors.append('missing local target: ' + dest)
+        elif parts.fragment and target.suffix.lower() in ['.md', '.mdx']:
+            if unquote(parts.fragment) not in anchors(target.read_text(encoding='utf-8')):
+                errors.append('missing local anchor: ' + dest)
+    return errors
+
+
+def check_repository(root):
+    errors, texts = [], []
+    for lang, filename in enumerate(['README.md', 'README.pt-BR.md']):
+        path = root / filename
+        if not path.is_file():
+            errors.append(filename + ': missing file')
+            continue
+        text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
+        texts.append(text)
+        if text.splitlines()[0] != NAV[lang]:
+            errors.append(filename + ': incorrect language selector')
+        if chr(0x2014) in text:
+            errors.append(filename + ': forbidden U+2014 separator')
+        if re.search(r'\{\{.+?\}\}|\b(?:TODO|TBD|PLACEHOLDER)\b|<YOUR[_ -]|<PROJECT[_ -]', text):
+            errors.append(filename + ': unresolved placeholder')
+        headings = re.findall(r'(?m)^## (.+)$', prose(text))
+        expected = [pair[lang] for pair in SECTIONS]
+        # Configuration is optional, but must be omitted in both languages.
+        if expected[3] not in headings:
+            expected.pop(3)
+        if [h for h in headings if h in expected] != expected:
+            errors.append(filename + ': required section order/inclusion differs')
+        for match in re.finditer(r'!\[([^\]]*)\]\(', prose(text)):
+            if not match[1].strip():
+                errors.append(filename + ': empty image alt text')
+        for match in re.finditer(r'<img\b[^>]*>', prose(text)):
+            if not re.search(r'\balt=["\'][^"\']+["\']', match[0]):
+                errors.append(filename + ': missing HTML image alt text')
+        if len(re.findall(r'(?m)^```', text)) % 2:
+            errors.append(filename + ': unbalanced fenced code')
+        errors.extend(filename + ': ' + e for e in check_links(path))
+    if len(texts) == 2:
+        blocks = [re.findall(r'(?ms)^```[^\n]*\n(.*?)^```', t) for t in texts]
+        if blocks[0] != blocks[1]:
+            errors.append('paired fenced examples differ; review technical equivalence')
+        for en, pt in SECTIONS:
+            if ('## ' + en + '\n' in texts[0]) != ('## ' + pt + '\n' in texts[1]):
+                errors.append('paired section presence differs: ' + en)
+    return {'repository': str(root.resolve()), 'ok': not errors, 'errors': errors}
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('repositories', nargs='+', type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    results = [check_repository(p) for p in args.repositories]
+    print(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2))
+    sys.exit(0 if all(r['ok'] for r in results) else 1)
